verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of any workspace-wide message export feature, compliance/eDiscovery tooling, or machine-readable bulk-export API in Buzz's docs — search over history (buzz-gh-3), admin dashboards (buzz-supp-admin-api), and audit trails for agents are documented, but none describe exporting full message history (including private conversations) for a team-admin. This is an applicable axis for a team-chat product but is simply unaddressed by any evidence item.
